checks.scope: A finite family of pairwise noncommensurable loxodromic WPD elements has a hyperbolically embedded family of maximal virtually cyclic subgroups. The single-element case applies; this is not a cubulation conclusion.

In a finitely generated group, an infinite-order element in a hyperbolically embedded virtually cyclic subgroup is Morse. In particular, word-metric geodesics between its powers stay uniformly near the cyclic subgroup.

A subgroup represented by a based graph has a local-isometry completion with the subgroup as fundamental-group image. A finite graph representing a subgroup quasiconvex for the cube-complex edge generating set has finite completion. The theorem does not assert cubulation of an arbitrary subsequent HNN extension.

the relevant Cayley word metric is exactly the combinatorial 1-skeleton metric
the bx circle represents the correct cyclic subgroup
